en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate Baroque pavilion opening onto a formal garden. The central building has a richly decorated façade with large arched windows, sculpted figures, and a domed roof topped by a sphere. Curved arcades with repeated arches extend to both sides, enclosing the garden. Manicured paths, hedges, and topiary trees line the foreground, with a few small human figures near the entrance for scale.
